data.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights

data.text: It's worth noting that the only modification the model made to improve itself was to reduce the length of its reasoning traces to avoid hitting the token limit. This is basically the same as the result from the recent weight-space programming article (https://rikiyat.github.io/blog/weight-space-programming/), which found that even Astra wasn't able to improve the performance of a model without this kind of obvious flaw.

Didn't Google's "sleep" paper already show this?https://research.google/blog/the-sleep-framework-a-new-way-f...  > During the offline sleep phase, the model unlocks pre-allocated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) memory blocks and updates its numerical weights using self-generated practice examples.

data.title: NINLIVE: The Nine Inch Nails live archive

data.text: I used to work with someone was really into NIN. I hadn't heard much of the music, still haven't to be honest. I just downloaded a show from that timeframe that I'll listen to later today.

Trent Reznor really wants his fans to get a high quality show out of the performance. The sound quality is always top notch and when there's a multimedia component, it's used to great effect. For example, alongside video footage with a mass surveillance theme, hidden cameras were pointed at sections of the audience and were streamed on stage. It was a delightful touch.
